title: HPLT 3.0: Very Large-Scale Multilingual Resources for LLM and MT Mono- and Bi-lingual Data, Multilingual Evaluation, and Pre-Trained Models
measurement_description: The paper did not conduct a direct measurement or evaluation of faith/religion. Instead, it observed and reported on the composition of its source data, noting the over-representation of religious content (specifically, biblical web pages) in the datasets for lower-resourced languages, particularly African languages, framing this as a potential source of bias.
findings: The paper found that biblical web pages constitute a large part of the content for smaller language datasets, especially for African languages. This over-representation of religious content is noted as a potential source of bias in these datasets.
